第1649 章 谁是天使文明正统传承（第1页）
长衡仙帝以大伟力，向多元宇宙，无尽位面和圣河天陆这三处有之地派出使者，询问是否有强者愿意一同超脱。
有志于成就有之地主宰的自然不会，但也有很多强者选择跟随。
仙庭诸军，无尽位面的强者军团，圣河天陆的军团，多元宇宙的军团全部到位。
其中什么圣河天陆的军团里，还有一部分白空天使和亚空天使。
白空天使的队列的领头人，是近年来最天才的天使天才，名为诺薇达莉。
已经在圣河天陆，成就圣神，复苏了身体内的一丝天主血脉，眼眸化为紫色。
甚至她的圣神异象，都是从未有人出现过的光明天堂山。
诺薇达莉心中的荣誉感迅速升起，她追寻着一切关于天使文明，天主的踪迹。
也曾驾驭真无之舟，远赴多元宇宙，探寻天使文明的遗迹。
在这段时间，她获得了大量关于天使文明的信息，也发现了许多拥有天使血脉的种族。
如今的七大有之地，真正的天使文明已经消失，残余的都是拥有天使血脉和天使传承的种族和文明。
她没有找到任何一个天使文明的正统传承人。
“据先祖典籍记载，我们白空天使这一支，源自于天使文明中的白空天使军团。”
“白空天使军团，是天使文明中的正统军团，全员都是天使真血。”
“所以，白空天使啊，在天使文明消失的今天，便是正统。”
“而我，身负天使血脉，便是天使文明的正统继承人，我要发扬天使文明的传承，弘扬天主的荣光。”
多元宇宙似乎对她敞开了幸运之门。

先是她找到了消失在多元宇宙无数年的原宇宙，在这里，她瞻仰观摩了天使文明崛起的历史痕迹。
“原来，我天使文明的最初，竟然是这些弱小的鹰人啊。”
“典籍所言，天使一族起于微末，并非是虚言。”
她又在时间的乱流里，被卷入了矗立于时间长河之上的神圣灯塔，在这里，她见证了天使文明的鼎盛造物，也得以窥见和学习天使文明留下的传承。
而等她回归圣河天陆，没过几年，便有长衡仙庭的使者在仙帝的伟力下来到圣河天陆，宣读仙帝的旨意。
因为在多元宇宙的那些年里，她早就知晓。
她带着一部分年轻的天使同族，毅然加入了仙庭的军团，并且和那些同样想要跟随仙帝的圣河天陆强者，并为一支军团。
对于一支白空天使的加入，仙庭自然是十分开心的。
连长衡仙帝，都亲自来此赐予她仙庭旗帜，感谢白空天使的加入。

Chapter 1649 Who is the orthodox inheritance of angel civilization (page 1)
Immortal Emperor Changheng used great power to send envoys to the three places of the multiverse, the endless plane and the holy river and sky, asking if there were any strong people who were willing to transcend together.
Those who are determined to become the masters of the land will naturally not do so, but there are also many strong people who choose to follow.
The armies of the Immortal Court, the legions of the powerful from the endless planes, the legions of the Holy River and Heavenly Land, and the legions of the multiverse are all in place.
Among the legions of the Holy River Sky Continent, there are also some White Sky Angels and Archon Angels.
The leader of the team of White Sky Angels is the most talented angel genius in recent years, named Novi Dali.
Already in the Holy River Sky Continent, he achieved the Holy Spirit, revived a trace of God's blood in his body, and his eyes turned purple.
Even her vision of the Holy Spirit was a mountain of light and heaven that no one had ever seen before.
The sense of honor in Novidali's heart quickly rose, and she pursued all traces of angelic civilization and God.
He also rode the boat of Zhenwu and traveled to the multiverse to explore the remains of angelic civilization.
During this time, she obtained a lot of information about angel civilization and discovered many races with angel blood.
In today's seven great lands, the real angel civilization has disappeared, and the only ones left are races and civilizations with angel blood and angel inheritance.
She did not find any orthodox inheritor of the angelic civilization.
"According to the ancient records, our branch of White Sky Angels originated from the White Sky Angel Legion in the angelic civilization."
"The White Sky Angel Legion is the orthodox legion in the angel civilization, and all its members are angels' true blood."
"So, White Sky Angel, today when angel civilization disappears, it is orthodoxy."
"And I, with the blood of angels, am the orthodox heir of angel civilization. I want to carry forward the inheritance of angel civilization and promote the glory of God."
The multiverse seems to have opened its doors to her.
First, she found the original universe that had disappeared in the multiverse for countless years. Here, she admired and observed the historical traces of the rise of angelic civilization.
"It turns out that the beginning of our angelic civilization was actually these weak eagle people."
"It is said in the classics that the angel family started from a young age, and it is not an empty lie."
In the turbulent flow of time, she was involved in the sacred lighthouse standing on the long river of time. Here, she witnessed the peak creation of the angel civilization, and was also able to glimpse and learn the inheritance left by the angel civilization.
And after she returned to the Holy River Sky Continent, within a few years, an envoy from the Changheng Immortal Court came to the Holy River Sky Continent under the power of the Immortal Emperor to read out the Immortal Emperor's will.
Because she had known it for a long time during those years in the multiverse.
She took some of her young angels with her and resolutely joined the Immortal Court's legion, and formed a legion with those strong men from the Holy River and Sky Continent who also wanted to follow the Immortal Emperor.
Xianting is naturally very happy about the addition of a team of White Sky Angels.
Immortal Emperor Chang Heng personally came here to give her the Immortal Court flag and thank the White Sky Angel for joining her.
